#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Currently the sonic-mgmt PR testing covers t0, t1-lag and sonic-t0.
We are going to cover the dualtor topology as well to run dualtor specific tests.

#### How did you do it?
First, I add a new agent pool and a vmss to manage agents in agent pool. Also, I modify the CustomScript to deploy dualtor environment in agent after the agent is created.
Then, I figure out the dualtor specific tests in `test/kvmtest.sh` to run on pipeline.

comments.author: wangxin
comments.body:
Suggest improving the PR title. This PR is not to add agent pool. It is to use the agent pool that has already been added by other efforts.

Maybe title 'Cover dualtor topology in PR testing' is a good one?

It would be great if you can improve the PR description to clearly describe what's the motivation, what have you done, etc.
